skill.name: prism-skill
skill.description: Prism Skill helps analyze events, claims, and partial context through selected disciplines, source-aware checks, clarifying questions, and structured outputs.
skill.summary: Multidisciplinary analysis skill for fact-aware reports and Markdown or HTML export.
skill.author: sevenwoood

security_audit.summary: Static alerts were reviewed against the skill context, and no executable malware, prompt injection, data exfiltration, or command execution intent was found. The alerts are attributable to installation documentation, Markdown inline code, CJK text entropy, and a large SVG banner with embedded PNG data. The remaining concerns are content hygiene and asset transparency rather than blocking security behavior.

remediation.issue: Large inline Base64 SVG asset creates obfuscation-style scanner noise.
remediation.suggestion: Replace assets/prism-skill.svg with a smaller vector SVG or reference the reviewed PNG asset directly.

remediation.issue: Installation docs reference hidden skill directories under the user home folder.
remediation.suggestion: State that these are standard manual install targets and users should review files before copying the skill.

remediation.issue: Example documents use specific dated fact-checking claims.
remediation.suggestion: Label examples as illustrative or replace them with evergreen examples that do not imply live verification.

content.value_statement: Complex questions often need facts, context, and a clear structure before they are useful. Prism Skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code build multidisciplinary reports with source-aware reasoning.
actual_capabilities: Selects one to three relevant disciplines for a user question.
Separates verified, uncertain, and inferred claims during fact-focused analysis.
Asks clarifying questions when the topic is vague or too broad.
Produces tables, lists, text flowcharts, Markdown, and plain text summaries.
Drafts self-contained interactive HTML report text when requested.
Adapts responses across Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish documentation.
limitations: It does not verify live news unless the host provides browsing or trusted source access.
It should not provide personal medical, legal, investment, or engineering instructions.
Generated HTML should be reviewed before sharing, especially when it includes user-provided content.
Deep analysis may be strongest in Chinese and English, as the README notes weaker depth in other languages.

use_cases.title: Explain Public Events
use_cases.description: Turn a news event into a clear analysis with causes, effects, and uncertainty notes.

use_cases.title: Review Claims Before Publishing
use_cases.description: Separate supportable facts from assumptions before writing a report or article.

use_cases.title: Create Structured Briefings
use_cases.description: Convert a discussion into a concise Markdown or HTML-ready briefing for stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single event or opinion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this event in plain language: [event]. Pick the most relevant discipline and explain the main causes and effects.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Real Claim
prompt_templates.prompt: Fact-check these claims before analysis: [claims]. Mark what is verified, uncertain, or unsupported, then explain the implications.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Lenses
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [topic] from economic, social, and legal perspectives. Ask one clarifying question if the scope is too broad.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Full Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use our recent discussion about [topic] to create a structured Markdown report, then prepare a self-contained interactive HTML version.

output_examples.input: The Fed raised rates. How does that affect households?
output_examples.output: Prism identifies economics and household finance as the main lenses. It explains loan costs, savings returns, employment pressure, and uncertainty in a concise report.

output_examples.input: Is this company layoff claim real, and what are the social effects?
output_examples.output: The skill separates verifiable claims from unsupported details. It then maps effects on workers, families, local markets, and public trust.

output_examples.input: Turn our climate policy discussion into a report.
output_examples.output: Prism organizes the discussion into sections, adds source notes where needed, and prepares Markdown or HTML-ready report text.

best_practices: State whether you need factual verification, interpretation, comparison, or report generation.
Provide dates, locations, actors, and known source links for current events.
Ask for the desired output format, such as table, plain text, Markdown, or HTML.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent missing sources, statistics, or case details.
Do not use it as the final authority for medical, legal, investment, or safety decisions.
Do not request HTML reports from unreviewed sensitive personal data.

faq.question: Does Prism Skill browse the web?
faq.answer: No by itself. It uses the host model and available tools. Ask for source checks when current facts matter.

faq.question: Is it a replacement for expert advice?
faq.answer: No. It can explain tradeoffs, but it should not give personal medical, legal, or investment instructions.

faq.question: Which languages does it support?
faq.answer: The docs cover Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish. Complex cases may be stronger in Chinese and English.

faq.question: Can it create HTML reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft self-contained interactive HTML report text when the user requests it.

faq.question: How does it handle vague questions?
faq.answer: It asks up to three clarifying rounds. It gives a general analysis if the scope remains broad.

faq.question: Does the skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill is instruction-only. Static alerts came from docs and image assets.
